caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on a plain background. The teapot has a rounded, somewhat bulbous body with a wide base, a short, ornate lid topped with a finial, a broad arched handle on the left, and a long, gently curving spout extending to the right. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a light beige paper, using a pencil or graphite medium. Reflections and highlights are indicated on the glossy surface of the teapot, showcasing its metallic material through lighter and darker shading. The overall composition is simple, with the teapot occupying most of the space and no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Teapot
